description: Defines classes and interfaces for F1-U split gateway and connector in a 5G network, including bearer management, tunnel attachment, and demux handling.

classes.name: f1u_split_gateway_cu_bearer
classes.description: Represents a bearer at the CU F1-U gateway, manages tunnel interfaces and SDU passing.

classes.name: f1u_split_connector
classes.description: Connects DU and CU-UP F1-U bearers, manages bearer creation, attachment, and disconnection.

methods.name: f1u_split_gateway_cu_bearer::stop
methods.description: Stops the bearer and associated resources.

methods.name: f1u_split_gateway_cu_bearer::get_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the bind address of the tunnel.

methods.name: f1u_split_gateway_cu_bearer::on_new_pdu
methods.description: Handles new PDU messages, passing them to the tunnel.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector::create_cu_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new CU bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector::attach_dl_teid
methods.description: Attaches downlink TEID information to the session.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector::disconnect_cu_bearer
methods.description: Disconnects a CU bearer based on uplink TEID info.
